result:
T-DG6-ARCH-17 is done in about 29 minutes (started 00:12:20Z, ended 00:41:24Z UTC). The ADRs, OpenAPI descriptions and data dictionary now match the shipped code for D-226 to D-229. Every required check exits 0. The changes are left uncommitted on `dg6/arch-17` for you to integrate.

**What changed (docs and descriptions only; no code, schema or migration)**
- **ADR-0051:** I fixed four outdated passages in place, each pointing to a new dated amendment of 2026-11-09:
  - the inbox redaction paragraph (line ~151);
  - the old `"[restricted]"` marker row;
  - the old `keepRestrictedLiterals` pairing rule;
  - the status line.

  The amendment covers:
  - the `[restricted:k]` tokens (k counts all literals of the stored version) and the 422 for an unknown token or the bare marker;
  - the inbox and channel redaction (link to the transformation home, no token, no params);
  - D-227 key masking and the action→case rule;
  - D-228 error-text masking and the item label;
  - D-229, the reference inventory counts, and the code I checked it against.
- **ADR-0054:** I corrected line ~94 and the `deepLinkUrl` comment, and added an amendment on what a channel sends to a restricted recipient.
- **ADR-0043:** this was not in the brief. I added a short amendment recording the new 422 `automation_rule.restricted_marker_unknown` with its exact English text. I left its refusal table alone because `fed.test.tsx` parses that table.
- **OpenAPI:** descriptions only, on 17 properties: the keys, error texts, link fields, actionable-error params, connector configuration (D-229) and `skipReason`. No type, pattern, enum or operation changed, and the version stays `1.5.0-p6`.
- **Data dictionary:** a pointer in each of the 12 affected table sections, plus a new final section with one row per column these tasks changed or classified.

**Checks (all exit 0)**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `validate --historical --stage DG5` (start and end) | PASS |
| `pnpm -r typecheck`, `pnpm -r build`, `pnpm lint` | clean |
| prettier over the whole tree | clean |
| `pnpm openapi:lint` | PASS, 932 operations |
| `validate --register DG6` | PASS |
| `pnpm test`, locale unset and `C.UTF-8` (same counts) | 190 files / 2899 tests; 123 / 2094; 3 / 259 with 2 skipped |
| API integration set (contract, failure queue, all of `operations/` including the BE-Z6 race test, the Z13 access and task tests, a13/a22) | 31 files / 443 tests |
| Worker integration set | 12 files / 75 tests |
| e2e a22 and a13, English and Arabic | 4 passed, no retries |

I wrote the ADR-0043 amendment after the locale-unset unit run had finished, while the `C.UTF-8` run was going. Only `fed.test.tsx` reads that file, so I re-ran it in both locales on the final text: 28/28 each.

**For you**
- **Stale inventory text:** in `sensitive-reference-inventory.ts`, the `fix` text of the `automation_rule_version.conditions` row still describes the old D-222 (2) rule. That file is test-support code outside a docs-only brief, so I left it for the backend owner. Only the description is wrong; the test results are not affected.
- **Unused skip reason:** the shipped worker never sets the `recipient_restricted` skip reason, because a restricted recipient is sent the restricted message instead. The docs now say so. I'm not proposing to remove the value, since that would need a migration and a contract change.

No pending operations to move, no new dependency, and no English or Arabic strings made untrue.

Everything is in `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG6/`: the handback is `T-DG6-ARCH-17-solution-architect.md`, and the logs are in `T-DG6-ARCH-17-evidence/`.
